variations.linkedin:
We're excited to share our latest build update for Context Engine, an AI-powered build-in-public automation tool for developers. 

Our team has been working tirelessly to improve the payload builder, and we're now supporting single or multi-screenshot sessions. This feature allows for more flexibility and accuracy in assembling data from various context sources.

Key features of our updated payload builder include:
- Assembling data from all context sources
- Supporting single or multi-screenshot sessions
- Enhanced security with secure deletion of sensitive content

We've also made significant improvements to our OCR confidence, now reliably reaching 65.8% and above. This enhancement enables more accurate text recognition and data extraction.

Our tool is designed to streamline development workflows, providing features such as:
- Automated payload building
- Real-time OCR confidence tracking
- Secure content handling

Developers can leverage Context Engine to automate tasks, reduce manual effort, and focus on high-priority projects.
